Product overview

The S300 combines an NC300 four-stroke engine with a full-size chassis, 21/18 wheel set and 11.4 L tank. It is configured for stable off-road performance, predictable control and dealer fleet purchasing.

Four-stroke engineNC300 power unit rated at 25 kW and 27 N·m.
Full-size geometry1500 mm wheelbase and 970 mm seat height.
Off-road suspension950 mm front fork and 480 mm rear shock.
Disc brakingFront and rear disc brakes for direct control.
